items.name: GitHub Constellation 2024
items.summary: Supported GitHub’s flagship Bengaluru developer conference from program planning through the on-site experience.
items.challenge: Deliver a high-quality, locally relevant conference while coordinating agencies and teams across the organization.
actions: Supported website management, venue logistics, speaker coordination, emceeing, and attendee engagement
Collaborated with external agencies and multiple internal teams
Helped deliver a program featuring 20+ speakers and a keynote by GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke
outcomes: A flagship event for India’s developer and open-source ecosystem

items.name: MongoDB User Groups
items.summary: Aligned and supported a global user-group program while helping local leaders build sustainable developer communities.
items.challenge: Create consistent support for established groups while launching or reviving chapters in new regions.
actions: Supported 40 existing MongoDB User Groups globally
Helped launch or revive chapters in Seoul, Abu Dhabi, Rio de Janeiro, and Cape Town
Served as the directly responsible individual for event operations across 24 user-group events
outcomes: A more consistent operating model for local community leaders

items.name: GitTogether Meetups Automation
items.summary: Built a four-stage automation pipeline for repeatable, multi-repository meetup operations.
items.challenge: Manual issue creation, assignment, and lifecycle tracking consumed time and introduced avoidable errors.
actions: Orchestrated workflows across repositories with GitHub Actions
Integrated GitHub GraphQL and REST APIs with Node.js
Moved program configuration into reusable YAML
outcomes: More consistent issue creation, assignment, and lifecycle management

media.alt: Diagram of the GitTogether meetup automation system
